annotations.text:
Three directions, same content so they compare directly.

Each has a Dark tweak above it.

Archival — one ink, one paper. Character from typography and restraint, no colour at all.

Editorial — the gazette number as the hero. One hot signal colour. Dark by default.

Civic — ochre, seal red, paper stock. Most rooted, most at risk of costume.

This is what is built and in PR #11 — the app-shell direction.

It works. It reads as any B2B dashboard, which is the problem we are fixing.

The qualifier logic survives whichever direction wins.

State as a recognised mark, only the consequence as words, each caveat scoped to the claim it weakens.
Unchanged. The flows were never the problem.
